content.comment_body: I'm unable to load a project onto my device. In the network view, I can go online and the LAN connection indicator is active, but I cannot make any online setting changes. I'm hoping for a creative solution.

Which [product_name] model and [product_name] software are you using? If you have the latest [product_name] version, you need [product_name] software version [version_no]. Can you explain why you can't download programs to your new [product_name] device?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing issues transferring a project to a [product_name] device via network view. Although the LAN connection and online monitoring work, project loading and online setting changes are unavailable. This suggests a possible mismatch between software and hardware versions, or software compatibility challenges, disrupting the workflow.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to load projects and perform online changes smoothly when the LAN connection is established and online communication is functional.
